scenario: Peter, a shy new junior tester, arrives for his first day. Kate walks him around and introduces everyone, so the whole episode is full of 'This is...', 'His name is...', 'Her desk is...', 'Are you...?', 'Is this your...?' and 'have got'. Kate: 'This is Den. His desk is by the window. That is his mug — don't touch it!' Den is very protective of his mug and his chair. Alex says he has got four kids, so the office is his quiet place. Pol gives Peter a smoothie and says 'My door is always open.' Peter mixes up the names at first ('Is your name Den?' to Alex) and everyone laughs kindly. Warm welcome, gentle humour. Use lots of possessive adjectives (my/your/his/her/our/their), be-questions (Are you...? Is this...?), and 'have got'. Keep sentences short and A2.
